expect.filtered_text: The BH and R programs are active.

rationale: ABBREVIATE reduces a detected value to the uppercase initials of its whitespace-separated words, so a two-word value yields two letters and a single-word value yields one.
Both forms appear in one document so the strategy is pinned for the multi-word and single-word cases together; an implementation that abbreviated only the first word would pass the second case alone.
The replacement is much shorter than the original, so this also pins that the surrounding text is reassembled at the right offsets.
